# Providers removed for Harbor

Harbor does not use TabCoder's `src/providers` (AI SDK wrappers for OpenAI / Ollama / Codestral).

LLM transport: Harbor `src/openaiClient.ts` + Settings `agentPanel.providers`.

Original upstream files are omitted from this Harbor fork snapshot path — see git history of
[alexandrevilain/tabcoder](https://github.com/alexandrevilain/tabcoder) if you need them for sync.
